features.title: Visual Questions
features.description: Some questions test your knowledge of German symbols and flags visually — pick the correct image, not just the correct text.

features.title: Multiple Choice Question
features.description: Engage with interactive multiple-choice questions on topics like politics, democracy, and German society. Choose the correct answer and test your knowledge in real-time.

features.title: Why Is This Correct?
features.description: Every question comes with a clear explanation of the correct answer, so you understand the reasoning instead of just memorizing.

features.title: Instant Translations
features.description: Translate any question and its answer options into your language with one tap, so nothing gets lost in translation while you study.

features.title: Flashcards
features.description: Review key German vocabulary from the questions with flip-to-reveal flashcards, complete with translations to help the terms stick.

features.title: Study Dashboard
features.description: Access all study modes, track your progress, and select your Bundesland for region-specific questions. This is your main hub for preparing for the 'Leben in Deutschland' or Einbürgerungstest.

features.title: Track Your Progress
features.description: See your overall completion, daily streak, and a breakdown by category to know exactly where to focus your studying next.

features.title: Mock Test Results
features.description: At the end of a mock test, review your performance. See the number of correct and incorrect answers, and get an encouraging message to keep practicing and improving.

features.title: Select Your Bundesland
features.description: Customize your study experience by selecting your Bundesland. This ensures that you get the specific regional questions relevant to your state in Germany.

features.title: Answer Feedback
features.description: Receive immediate feedback on your answers. Correct responses are highlighted in green, while incorrect ones appear in red, helping you learn and improve your understanding of key topics.
